summary: Adam Mair is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre who played in the National Hockey League. The note lists the NHL teams he played for: the Toronto Maple Leafs, Los Angeles Kings, Buffalo Sabres and New Jersey Devils. It also notes that he is currently a player development coach for the Buffalo Sabres.
one_line: Canadian former NHL centre who played for four clubs and now works as a Buffalo Sabres player development coach.
